risk_note: RV2 (admin authorization boundary). AdminOperationGuard takes a single permission point or an array: read-only operations (readOnly) pass when the admin holds any of the points, with no step-up and no token read or consumed; write operations pass with any point of an array whose points share one step-up tier (specs/permissions.yaml), then follow the existing token flow; mixed tiers or an empty array are a programming error 50001 before the business callback and before any token is consumed; a single point keeps the F1-06l / F1-06u behaviour; super admins hold every point. No new runtime export from platform/http/index.ts. Implemented by Codex (approvals 30 / 31), rule tests by a Claude subagent. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
